How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.niperraebareli.edu.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 24-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIPER IT Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the NIPER IT Assistant post is 24th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the IT Assistant position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or an MCA from a recognized University/Institute. Additionally, three years of relevant experience is required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the IT Assistant position is 40 years. No minimum age limit is specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the IT Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the IT Assistant position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 42,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the NIPER IT Assistant job?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this NIPER IT Assistant recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the IT Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve screening of applications, followed by a test and/or interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The IT Assistant position is a contractual role at the National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research (NIPER).

faq.question: Q9. Where is NIPER located?
faq.answer: NIPER is located in Uttar Pradesh, with the specific city mentioned as Lucknow, and the pincode as 226002.

faq.question: Q10. What kind of experience is required for the IT Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates need at least three years of experience in data management, website management, hardware management, and network management.
